This was my first time tripping on research chemicals and I had no idea what to expect. I was 16 years old at the time and it was a cold winter day. My friend ( we'll just call him R) calls me at about 3:30 P.M. He's clearly excited and telling me all about this new drug he has. I told him to give me 2 cpsules, about 20mg. Each. He drops them off at roughly 4:00 P.M. As soon as I got them I followed his directions by openning the capsules and downing the contents with water. I'm waiting for what seems like forever. I'm getting pissed thinking that all I'll get out of this is a taste of nasty chemicals and a stomache ache. Well out of nowhere it hits me the walls are moving, I feel like I just snorted a gram of pure colombian cocaine. I turn on my Ipod the music is flowing through me, I see the Ipod symbol leave the Ipod and float throught the air. I find this amazing and continue to watch it for an hour. The rest of my trip I spent chain smoking and watching the trails off my cigarette which were simply amazing, and using glowsticks to create amazing visuals. All I can tell you about his drug is that it has the body high of ecstacy with the visuals of LSD. Simply amazing.
